messages:
natalie: Hey infra, need quota entitlements raised in AWS account 987654321098 for a new eu-west-8 onboarding. Helix needs p5/g5/p4d capacity. Requesting P5: 8, G5: 20, P4d: 2. Also ENI + IPv4 increases (see numbers below). Target deploy window ~2024-05-30.

lee: Can you confirm the full 12-digit account (got it), steady-state vs peak, and which AZs you plan to use? EU-WEST-8 has tighter entitlements right now.

natalie: Account is 987654321098 (prod-helix). Steady: p5=4, g5=10, p4d=1. Peak: p5=8, g5=20, p4d=2 for perf runs. ENIs: +100, IPv4 addresses: +150. VPC CIDR is 10.0.0.0/21 so we may run out of priv IPs if we don't bump.

anya: FYI eu-west-8 is a newer region, AWS sometimes requires business justification and monthly spend estimates. I'll open the case but need a short justification and estimated monthly bill to include.

natalie: Short justification: production inference for EU customers, DR for eu-west-2, and compliance boundary for Helix customers. Estimated monthly: ~$42,000 (reserved pool + variable inference). Include "production inference for Helix" and mention reserved vs burst patterns.

sasha: Also make sure the AWS case asks for "Elastic network interfaces per Region" and "IPv4 addresses per Region" increases otherwise instances can fail to attach NICs. Do we need any VPC or subnet increase (e.g., ENI-per-instance limits)?

natalie: Please request: Elastic Network Interfaces +100, IPv4 addresses +150, GPU instance family quotas: P5 -> 8, G5 -> 20, P4d -> 2. If they ask, we can provide a PO.

lee: I'll prepare the internal quota uplift PR. Anya, when you open the AWS support case use this template:
```
Account: 987654321098
Region: eu-west-8
Requested increases:
  - p5 family instances: 8 total
  - g5 family instances: 20 total
  - p4d instances: 2 total
  - Elastic Network Interfaces (ENIs) per region: +100
  - IPv4 addresses per region: +150
Business justification: production inference for Helix, low-latency EU traffic and redundancy.
Estimated monthly spend: ~$42k
Preferred timeline: 2024-05-30
```

anya: Opening case now, attaching runbook and cost estimate. AWS asked for launch timeline and architecture notes (we're behind ALB + NATs, private subnets). I'll paste case# when created.

infra-bot: :white_check_mark: Quota request ticket created (internal ref Q-2024-5643). Blocking flag set on Helix eu-west-8 deploy until quotas confirmed.

natalie: Thanks. One more: is there an internal cost center code we should put on the PO for reserved capacity? Need finance sign-off.

sasha: Finance sign-off required for any reserved capacity commit. For initial onboarding we can start on-demand while awaiting quota approval; reserved commit only after traffic patterns stabilized.

lee: Once AWS approves I'll schedule capacity reservations and update the onboarding runbook and the ENI/IP change list. Tagging @sre to monitor for ENI exhaustion during initial boot.

anya: Case opened: AWS case 98765-2024-ABCD. AWS responded asking for contact info and expected start date. I replied with timeline 2024-05-30 and pointed them to the justification above. Will update here if they approve or request more details.

infra-bot: :rotating_light: AWS support: initial review complete, may require entitlements team approval. ETA 48-72 hours.

natalie: Great — please escalate if they push back on p5 family, those are critical for our latency SLOs.

sasha: Noted. If entitlements are slow we can prioritize g5 capacity in nearby region as fallback but that will increase cross-region cost and latency.

lee: Good plan. Keep updates coming and include any case IDs or screenshots of the limits page so we can track approvals in the onboarding checklist.
